about_the_game:
Evil stirs. Not only does a deadly plague ravage the land, consuming entire villages, but rumours abound that the long-forgotten old gods including Despater, the God of Death, have awakened from slumber. Join Betha, a mysterious girl with a powerful secret, and the survivors of Tadec on a desperate quest to uncover the truth and destroy the source of the blight.

Traverse a rich medieval fantasy world across 32 branching scenarios and confront the evil that schemes in the shadows. The choices you make – who you choose to ally with, who you leave behind, and what you’re willing to sacrifice – will shape the fate of the world.

Key features

Tactical turn-based combat

Maneuver your team, choose your actions wisely, and outwit your enemies using terrain, timing, and tactical insight. Classic party-based strategy: Form your party from a diverse array of warriors, each with their unique skills, strengths, and stories.

Difficult Decisions

Every encounter presents the risk of character perma-death. When a party member dies, will you forge ahead with a replacement, or reload and try again? Who will you recruit and who will you leave behind?

A rich, driving story

An epic narrative inspired by Celtic mythology and medieval folklore. Rich world-building, character-driven storytelling, and branching paths that reflect your decisions ensure each playthrough feels fresh.

Dynamic character progression

Customise your party with new skills and equipment earned through battle. Develop your heroes into hardened veterans.

Tactical multiplayer battles

Design your own party, test your skills, and go join your friends in intense skirmishes.

An immersive, replayable campaign

With branching choices, region-specific recruits, and difficult decisions ahead, no two journeys are ever the same.

short_description: In this turn-based tactical combat RPG, lead your heroes across a medieval world inspired by Celtic mythology and uncover the source of a terrible plague. The God of Death has returned, unleashing a blight before him. Choose your allies, shape your party, and make the tough choices.
